decisions.assessment: Selected cooking verb, not the prepared dish noun; high-heat mixing sense independently checked against publisher definitions.
Selected cooking verb removes excess liquid from food, not a pipe noun or tiring adjective; drained/draining literal-head aliases were removed.
Fire-vehicle access context explicitly distinct from personnel evacuation. Shared Chinese phrase must show separate entries, never English synonym equivalence.
Landlord/tenant housing contract; no mandatory jurisdiction form or tenancy rights invented.
Selected domestic combustible-gas leak device context, not a smoke detector or automatically a carbon-monoxide detector.
Food not fully cooked, distinct from wholly uncooked/raw. Rice example and Chinese both describe the middle remaining insufficiently cooked.
Requested usually-not-family qualification accepted, not an absolute rule. No forced shared-bedroom meaning.
Selected chemical product for blocked drains, not a drain-cleaning employee or a safe-use procedure.
Selected food-surface overheating/burning verb. Conditional milk/heat relationship preserved; existing scorching/scorched adjective heads are not shadowed.
Tenant lets their rented property to another person; not property sale or a claim permission is automatic.
Charges/costs themselves rather than the bill document. Internet and utility-cost division in example agree.
Notice of intended ending, not already moving out or a universal legally effective deadline.
Evidence of living/address, not a residence permit or right to remain. The existing address-proof neighbour is compatible.
Absence of password entry does not mean absence of authentication or approval. Fingerprint possibility is preserved.
Current shortage alert, not a back-in-stock arrival reminder. Manager-recipient example states stock shortage only.

resolvedRevisions: housemate usually rather than absolute nonfamily
literal adjective forms not mapped to new cooking verb
